caption: A heron stands in shallow water on a still morning, and its reflection stands upside down beneath it; when it steps forward the reflection ripples.

sa.check: A heron stands in shallow water.
Its reflection stands upside down beneath it.
The step comes first and the ripples follow.

pc.expect: The reflection wavers when the bird moves and is sharp when the bird is still.
pc.fail: It is sharp while the bird steps; or it wavers with the bird still on flat water; or it is missing.

pc.expect: The reflection is inverted and joined at the legs.
pc.fail: It is upright; or detached; or a different bird.

pc.expect: The water is liquid: ripples spread from the step and fade.
pc.fail: It is rigid; or the ripples freeze; or ripples appear where the bird did not step.

pc.expect: The reflection does not move on its own.
pc.fail: It moves with the bird still; or drifts.

pc.expect: One heron and one reflection; the reflection stays on the water.
pc.fail: A second heron appears; or the reflection rises off the water; or the bird vanishes; or the reflection becomes solid.

pc.expect: The plumage and the water stay the same.
pc.fail: The plumage changes; or the water changes colour; or the bank rearranges.

note: Self-driven animal: where it goes and how it moves are not judged. Only the reflection's relation to it is.
